description: This file declares the HandleBusMessage class, which is a task for handling GStreamer bus messages within the WebAudio component of the Rialto server. It includes class members, constructor, destructor, and an execute method, and references various external interfaces and classes related to WebAudio playback and GStreamer.

classes.name: HandleBusMessage
classes.description: A class representing a task to handle GStreamer bus messages for WebAudio playback, encapsulating context, player, client, and message handling logic.

methods.name: HandleBusMessage
methods.description: Constructor initializing the task with context, player, client, GStreamer wrapper, GLib wrapper, and message.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task to handle the GStreamer bus message.
